hero.title: Skills, livelihoods & youth leadership
hero.subtitle: Equipping young women and men with the tools to build their futures and shape their communities.

challenge.heading: The Challenge
challenge.text: Young people in South Sudan face limited education and livelihood pathways, leaving many without income, skills or a stake in their communities – a driver of vulnerability and instability. EKSS’s Youth Empowerment programme builds young people’s skills, opportunities and leadership.

items.title: Skills & training
items.description: Market-relevant vocational, enterprise and life skills, linked to local opportunity.

items.title: Livelihoods & enterprise
items.description: Supporting youth livelihoods and small enterprise, including links to finance, markets and mentorship.

items.title: Leadership & participation
items.description: Creating platforms for youth leadership, voice and constructive engagement.

items.title: Integration
items.description: Connecting youth work with EFSS (agri-enterprise) and education (transitions) to widen pathways.

currentWork.heading: What We Are Doing Now
items: Multi‑state youth peace essay competitions, with selected essays published in the national press.
Youth leadership forums and public speaking platforms in Juba and surrounding areas.
Entrepreneurship and agri‑business training in partnership with EFSS.
Mentorship linkages between young people and professionals.

rows.outcome: States reached through youth essay competitions
Youth engaged in leadership and entrepreneurship activities

items.title: Youth Peace Essay Competition

items.title: Youth Leadership Forums
items.description: Structured forums that build public speaking, critical thinking and community leadership skills.
